what: Equity LifeStyle Properties owns manufactured home communities, RV resorts and campgrounds, many of them in Florida, Arizona and California, and rents out the sites rather than the homes.
customers: Retirees living in its communities, RV travellers and members of its Thousand Trails campground network.
money: annual site rents in residential communities
annual, seasonal and transient site rents
moat: Waterfront and retirement-destination land that cannot be permitted again. Many of its Florida properties could not be built today at any price.
risks: Revenue has been flat at $1.5B for three years
Transient RV and camping stays are discretionary and fall first in a downturn
30 times earnings for a landlord growing rents in the low single digits
opportunities: $372M of free cash flow and a 26.2% net margin
Annual site renters, the bulk of income, stay for years and renew at high rates
Analysts see about 13% upside, with 19 covering the stock
watch: Core community rent growth and occupancy in the annual RV sites.
